meta.title: Code map
meta.description: Project-scoped code graph tools backed by codemap: search code, find symbols, read symbol detail, trace call chains and type hierarchies, inspect dependencies and graph stats, run read-only Cypher, and search project knowledge. One registration serves every workspace: each call resolves the session's working directory to its repository, starts a codemap process for that repository on first use, and recycles it after ten idle minutes.
